newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Apex to buy stake in Philippine firm.
newsitem.headline: Apex to buy stake in Philippine firm.

text.p: Malaysia's Apex Equity Holdings Bhd said on Wednesday it has agreed to take up a 7.5 percent stake in Philippine property developer, Belle Bay City Corporation (BBCC) for a total investment of $21.75 million.

BBCC is to undertake a rationalisation exercise by increasing its authorised capital to 6.0 billion pesos, from the present 400,000, of which 1.56 billion pesos is to be issued and subscribed, Apex said in a statement.

BBCC is developing the Belle Bay City Business Park, a 19 hectare property in the central business district of Manila Bay reclamation area. Construction of the project is scheduled to commence early next year with completion expected by 2000.
Apex said estimated cost of the project is $55 million.
